name: lesson-recap-a
title: Lesson recap: centred results card with ring fill, burst and reveal; bounded Deep Dive panel with remix
issue: Issue #86. Implement Option A of the approved design proposal at C:/Users/epicn/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/E--Code-Projects-Qamooscheh-Web-Qamooscheh-Web/8bcc13c3-742b-454a-8f3b-63611fceadd8/scratchpad/issue86-design.md (mockups issue86-mockups.html in the same folder; read both fully). USER CHANGES TO THE PROPOSAL: (1) ANIMATION SEQUENCE on a pass: first the score ring/bar FILLS with an eased cubic (or quadratic) curve, e.g. ease-out cubic; ONLY WHEN the fill finishes does the confetti-style burst play, and ONLY THEN are the title, score text and stat tiles revealed (text hidden before then). Perfect lesson gets the bigger burst and 'Perfect lesson!' title. Failed lesson: calm amber ring that fills with the same easing, no burst, text revealed after the fill. Drive the sequence from one small state machine or hook (fill -> burst -> reveal) so it is testable, and keep the count-up consistent with the ring. Reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion) shows the final state immediately with at most a short fade, and fixes LessonResults which ignores it today across the 6 pages using it. Hide the burst under forced-colors. No new dependencies, no art assets. (2) DEEP DIVE PANEL: one bounded secondary panel whose height does not grow with topic count. Primary action in the panel: 'Remix these topics' which navigates to /lesson/deep-dive-remix?themeIds=<comma-separated ids of ALL the lesson's root-tag themes (lessonThemes in LessonPage.tsx)>, an existing route. At most 3 topic chips as secondary 'browse this topic' links (existing navigation to /themes/<id>?from=<skill>), plus a '+N more' chip that opens the existing DeepDiveChooserModal (all depths, 'Remix all topics'). Only show the panel when showDeepDiveBridge is true as today. Follow the risks section of the proposal (stale streak/daily-goal on first paint, no double goal celebration on mobile, goal tile must not animate). Keep behaviour of submission, XP, next-lesson and replay logic unchanged; this is presentation plus the remix button. Add unit tests for pure logic (sequence state machine, easing, topic chip/overflow selection). Put per-component details the proposal specifies (LessonRecap, ScoreRing, RecapStats, DeepDivePanel, useCountUp, ghost Button variant) as it describes. List in the PR body: what the recap looks like per state and the Not verified items (not run in a browser).
acceptance: Ring fills with a cubic/quadratic ease, then burst, then text reveals; failed lesson fills without a burst
prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state immediately, including on the other pages using LessonResults
Deep Dive panel has a Remix these topics button (all lesson root tags), up to 3 browse chips and a +N more chip opening the chooser modal; height constant
lint, tsc -b, build, test green locally and in CI
